---
title: Sweet and Sour Shrimp
id: MAR-0010
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 45
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 500 g prawn tails
- to taste grated zest of ½ orange
- 80 g beetroot
- 80 g mayonnaise
- 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Rinse the prawn tails and cook them in boiling lightly salted water for 2 minutes.
2. Drain them, remove the shell and the intestinal vein.
3. Cut the beetroot into small cubes and put it in the blender with the vinegar and mayonnaise; blend until smooth.
4. Place the mixture on a serving plate, sprinkle with the orange zest, lay the prawn tails on top and serve.
